UTS Robotics Institute: Towards Robot Skill Learning and Adaptation with Gaussian Processes — A.K.M. Nadimul Haque, Fouad Sukkar, Sheila Sutjipto, Cedric Le Gentil, Marc G. Carmichael, Teresa Vidal-Calleja. Sparse via-point GPs for structured skill adaptation and sim-to-real.

UKAEA: Geometrically-Exact Model-Based Trajectory Optimisation for Robotic Manipulation of Highly Flexible Payloads — Samuel Herschmann, Kaiqiang Zhang, Robert Skilton. Cosserat-beam payloads; EuroFusion / UK Atomic Energy Authority.
Same UKAEA flexible-payload poster, closer crop.
CUHK: A Novel Design for an Amphibious Robot with Cable-driven Flexible Surfaces as Legs — P.K. Katy To, Jingjun Liu, Darwin Lau. Soft-legged quadruped for land and water (pool-noodle buoyancy).
Researchers in front of the CUHK amphibious-robot poster.
CUHK amphibious-robot poster with presenters.

UCLA Robotics and AI Institute: EMPM — Embodied MPM for Modeling and Simulation of Deformable Objects — Yutuo Chen, Yalei Hu, Lingfeng Sun, Tushar Kusnur, Laura Herlant, Chenfanfu Jiang. Differentiable material-point method from RGB-D. embodied-mpm.github.io
Neighbouring deformable-objects / simulation poster in the same cluster as EMPM (aisle D4).

University of Michigan ROAHM Lab: TrackDeform3D — Markerless Autonomous 3D Keypoint Tracking and Dataset for Deformable Objects. Yeheng Zong, Yizhou Chen, Alexander Bowler, Chia-Tung Yang, Ram Vasudevan. Dual Franka arms + RGB-D, 85 min, 6 objects.
Chuo University Nakamura Lab: Urinary catheter insertion assist using a low-pressure water-hydraulic soft growing actuator for urethral stenosis.
Seoul National University: TIDY — Thermal Infrared Image Denoising via Wavelet Domain Entropy and Directional Stripe Index. Tai Hyoung Rhee, Dong-guw Lee, Ayoung Kim. SCAN-TIR dataset.
Università Ca’ Foscari / Padova: A Multi-Layer Navigation System for Smart Wheelchairs with a Limited Input Interface. 99.72% task completion, 0 collisions in the reported study.
STGA-VAE: Closed-Loop Stroke Rehabilitation Robot Control via Semi-Supervised Gait Quality Estimation with Spatio-Temporal Graph Attention.
Vanderbilt Kuntz Lab / VISE: Bayesian Retraction Optimization for Tissue Attachment Mapping in Surgical Dissection. Shing-Hei Ho, Bao Thach, Toan Vo, James M. Ferguson, Alan Kuntz.
Duke Brain Tool Lab / Louisville: TAGR — Tendon-Actuated Galvanometer Robot towards minimally invasive hybrid surgical laser steering. Kent K. Yamamoto, Behnam Moradkhani, et al.
Presenters in front of the Duke/Louisville TAGR surgical-laser poster.
TAGR poster with presenters.

Imperial College London (Edward Johns / Robot Learning Lab) with UCLA: Simlify — spatial reasoning / real-to-sim from a single view (Dmytro Osypeliukh, Yalei Hu, Ran Gong, Brandon May, Tushar Kusnur, … Edward Johns, Xiaohan Zhang). Colleague lab at Imperial.

Oregon State CoRIS / Ross L. Hatton (IROS 2026 Program Chair): Coordinate-Independent Robot Model Identification — Yanhao Yang, Ross L. Hatton. Geometric system ID on a crawler-pendulum and three-link robot.
Stony Brook: Path-Constrained Admittance Control for Human-Robot Interaction via Screw Theory. Maede Boroji, Vahid Danesh, Nilanjan Chakraborty, Imin Kao, Amin Fakhari. Franka Panda path compliance.
Workspace Analysis and Capacity Evaluation for a Soft Surface End-effector of a Cable-driven Parallel Robot — Morphology Primitives for infinite-DoF soft EE.

Caltech ARCLab / JPL: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control. Min Kim, Jose Leonardo Brenes, Fred Hadaegh, Soon-Jo Chung. Tracked vehicle + slosh/pendulum.
Johns Hopkins / Wilmer Eye Institute: Modeling and simulation of a heterogeneous over-constrained robot for vitreoretinal surgery (ERM peeling).
Safe Consensus of Cooperative Manipulation with Hierarchical Event-Triggered Control Barrier Functions (dual-arm real-world + Monte Carlo).
Carnegie Mellon / Case Western: wearable proportional-grip hand exoskeleton with ML-based force control from EMG (McMahon and collaborators).
Close-up of an IROS 2026 badge (McMahon, CMU / Case Western) — handy for a blog hero crop.
Seoul National University HERO Lab: Kresling origami structure based haptic device for gripping feedback. Taejoon Um, Minjae Lee, Sanghyeon Lee, Jeongmin Lee, Amy Kyungwon Han.
Caltech: semantic/social adaptive CBF safety — SAG / Poisson safety functions (Wilkinson, Bahati, Bena, Ames and collaborators).

Caltech AMBER Lab: Full-Body Dynamic Safety for Robot Manipulators — 3D Poisson Safety Functions for CBF-Based Safety Filters. Meg Wilkinson, Gilbert Bahati, Ryan M. Bena, Emily Fourney, Joel W. Burdick, Aaron D. Ames.
Inflatable skin with internal time-of-flight depth sensing (soft tactile/geometry skin poster).
University of Michigan: Novel Design of Large-Scale Origami Soft Arm with High Payload. Mingxuan He, Jiaming Wang, Yurui You, Xing Zhang, Haobo Fang, Jiaqi Wang, Xiaonan Huang. ~25 lb axial payload.
University of Alabama: MinTWorm — miniature tensegrity worm for locomotion and payload transport. Christian Azoleas, Jiajun An, Fatt Zhang, et al.

Cambridge / UC San Diego / Zaragoza: Policy Gradient with Self-Attention for Model-Free Distributed Nonlinear Multi-Agent Games. Eduardo Sebastián, Maitrayee Keskar, et al. Drone swarms, robot soccer, driving.
Hand holding the DirectHop insect robot (see following poster).

University of Washington AIR Lab: DirectHop — a direct-drive insect-sized robot that controls jump height and self-rights. Hanquan Wang, Yash P. Talwekar, Sawyer B. Fuller. 1.0 g, climbs a 17 cm stair.
DirectHop poster, closer crop of the mechanism.
DirectHop robot in the palm of a hand — 1-gram jumper.
Multi-DoF planar linkage synthesis for leg designs — Fuchen Chen, Aniruddha Anand Damle, Daniel M. Aukes. Open-source GPU linkage optimiser.
Same linkage-synthesis poster, alternate angle.
Same linkage-synthesis poster; 3D-printed blue linkage sample in the next frame.
3D-printed linkage sample from the Aukes-lab poster.

Singapore / MIT: Two-Finger Soft Gripper with a Scaled-Pad Contact Interface for Dual-Mode Grasping and Surface Cleaning. Luis Hernandez-Barraza, Zhi Cong Wong, … Fabio Duarte, Daniela Rus (SMART / Manus and Machina / MIT).
